book.name: 1 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ye embere ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Nangʉ nɨragamba igʉrʉ wi ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ bhɨsɨngɨɨrwɨ amasambwa. Tʉmɨnyirɨ kʉbha, itwʉsi tʉnʉ ʉbhʉmɨnyi. Nawe ʉbhʉmɨnyi bhʉrakora abhaatʉ bhiiyʉngɨ. Nawe ʉbhʉsɨɨgi nebhwe bhʉkʉbhakongʼya abhaatʉ mubhwisirirya.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ ariirora amɨnyirɨ ringʼana obhorebhe, wuyo akɨɨrɨ komenya ryʉryʉsi chɨmbu akwenderwa komenya.
Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ amʉsɨɨgirɨ Mungu, wuyo newe amɨnyɨkɨɨnɨ na Mungu.
Nangʉ igʉrʉ wu kurya ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ bhɨsɨngɨɨrwɨ amasambwa, tʉmɨnyirɨ kʉbha amasambwa ganʉ gakosengerwa, gatarɨ kegero kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ. Na tʉmɨnyirɨ kʉbha areho Mungu wʉmwɨbhu.
Nɨ‑maheene abhaatʉ abhandɨ bhariiseega kʉbha kʉna amasambwa mwisaarʉ na kʉʉsɨ. Maheene, kone ebhegero bhyaru bhɨnʉ abhaatʉ bhakʉbhɨbhɨrɨkɨra amasambwa hamwɨ abhakʉrʉ.

Nawe kwa niitwɨ, areho Mungu wʉmwɨbhu, newe Bhaabha, newe aatɨɨmirɨ ebhegero bhyʉsi. Itwɨ turiikara igʉrʉ waazɨ. Na areho Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wʉmwɨbhu, newe Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, ne ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨkateemwa kʉhɨtɨra kwawɨ, na niitwɨ bhahʉru tʉrɨ kʉhɨtɨra kwawe.

Nawe ɨtarɨ abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhaana ʉbhʉmɨnyi bhuyo, kʉ kʉbha bhareho abhandɨ bhanʉ bhaarɨ ni isimʉka yo okosengera amasambwa. Nʉʉrʉ nangwɨnʉ bhararya ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ bhɨsɨngɨɨrwɨ amasambwa, ibhyakurya bhiyo bhɨrabhakora kwiseega amasambwa. Hayo bhariirora mozekoro zaabhʉ kʉbha bharakora ʉbhʉbhɨ, kʉ kʉbha bhakɨɨrɨ kokongʼa mubhwisirirya.
Nawe ibhyakurya bhɨtakʉtʉtʉʉra haguhɨ na Mungu, kʉ kʉbha nʉʉrʉ turiitigɨ kurya, tʉtakubhurya kegero, nʉʉrʉ turiiryɨ, tʉtakwongerwa kegero.
Nawe mwiyangarɨrɨ bhwaheene, umweya gwanyu gʉtabha goreendeerya bhanʉ bhakɨɨrɨ kokongʼa mubhwisirirya.

Nɨrabhugabhu, kʉ kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akɨɨrɨ kokongʼa mubhwisirirya, arɨɨbhɨ arakorora awɨ wʉnʉ ʉmɨnyirɨ kʉbha amabhirʉbhirʉ gataana ʉbhʉhʉru, ʉrarya ibhyakurya mwihekaaru ryʉ ʉkʉsabhɨra amabhirʉbhirʉ, atakwiseega mokoro yaazɨ kʉbha wʉʉsi areenderwa kurya ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ bhɨsɨngɨɨrwɨ amabhirʉbhirʉ?
Kʉnzɨra yiyo, umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichazʉ wʉnʉ akɨɨrɨ kokongʼa mubhwisirirya, wʉnʉ Kiriisitʉ aamukuuriirɨ, ararika igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉmɨnyi bhwazʉ.
Arɨɨbhɨ mʉrasariirya abhiisirirya abhakɨndichanyu bhanʉ bhakɨɨrɨ kokongʼa mubhwisirirya, bhakore ʉbhʉbhɨ, na kʉbhanyahaara zekoro zaabhʉ, hayo mʉrabha mʉrasariirya Kiriisitʉ.
Kʉgayo, arɨɨbhɨ ibhyakurya bhɨnʉ nikurya, bhɨragirya umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichanɨ akore ʉbhʉbhɨ, nɨtakurya zee ɨnyama ye eteemwa yiyo, korereke nɨtaaza kugirya umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichanɨ akore ʉbhʉbhɨ.
